retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key portrait featuring gold jewelry against a deep black background with wide-tracked sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: gold chains and rings on black background
excludeWhen: bright or colorful backgrounds are required
playful or casual themes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic, close-up portrait of a subject's lower face and clenched fists, heavily shadowed to emphasize metallic gold textures and skin detail against a void-like black environment.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between reflective gold jewelry and matte black background
Symmetrical composition of hands framing the lower face
Top-down lighting creating deep shadows under the brow and chin
Minimalist white typography balanced at the top and bottom margins
coreInvariants: Deep black negative space surrounding the central subject
Metallic gold as the primary texture and highlight source
Wide letter-spacing in all-caps sans-serif text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centralized close-up; hands and lower face occupy the middle 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The reflective gold rings and chains in the center of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright gold jewelry, move up to the lips, then down to the bottom title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space at the top, bottom, and sides to create a sense of mystery and focus.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with low overall saturation, except for the warm yellow-gold tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying tracking and placement for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Parental Advisory label in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric structure matches the modern urban aesthetic.
Geometric 'O' and sharp points align with the minimalist layout.
Open-source alternative with similar geometric proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key portrait of a person's lower face and clenched fists against a pure black background. The person should be wearing heavy, ornate gold rings and thick gold chains. Use dramatic top-down lighting to highlight the metallic textures and skin details while leaving the rest in deep shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add all-caps sans-serif text in white. Place the artist name at the top center and the title at the bottom center. Use extremely wide tracking (letter-spacing) to span the width of the subject.

verificationChecks: Is the typography all-caps with wide tracking?
Are the gold textures highly reflective?
Is the lighting dramatic and high-contrast?

mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or logos
Ensure the Parental Advisory label is a generic placeholder if used
postGenerationChecks: Check for pure black levels in shadows
Ensure gold highlights are not blown out
Confirm wide tracking is consistent across all text lines
recipe.reuseFormula: Dramatic Low-Key Portrait + Ornate Gold Accents + Wide-Tracked Geometric Sans-Serif
